== Summary ==
Decipher's errata for Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed: the entry “Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed” in Decipher's ''Star Wars CCG Glossary Supplement'' (updated 29 January 2002), PDF page 6. Image for [[Rebel Strike Team / Garrison Destroyed (Decipher Errata 2002)]].

Source: [http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf swccgglossarysupplement.pdf], archived copy [https://web.archive.org/web/20041106202626/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossarysupplement.pdf 20041106202626]; wiki copy [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf]] (SHA-1 <code>3f9a040eca571154b142ffc52e3ac36f16045c02</code>). Cut unchanged from a 300 dpi render of PDF page 6 (pdftoppm -r 300), around the entry's title and revised game text with a margin of up to 6 points.

SHA-1 <code>e59298a4309c8cd11cf336d6374914f9e557ac40</code>, SHA-256 <code>12150a19e95ea851b2490abcd419bad69f6d012a0949045acbe111b6d8563c51</code>.
